provenance.note: Revolvers with a 3 in barrel and pistols that fit the 180 x 140 x 40 mm box (C.7D.1). The course runs at 15, 10, 7 and 3 m on one or two NPA faces, the book does not say who chooses. The record holds the longest distance.
